handoff.preWriteRule: Before starting each work unit write partialActionState: 'starting <task>' to status file. After completing write partialActionState: null and increment workUnitsCompleted.
handoff.staleLeasePolicy: If status is ACTIVE but lastHeartbeatAt is older than leaseDurationMinutes, probe-handoff.ps1 auto-writes HANDOFF_READY with handoffTrigger watchdog_stale_lease.
